headline: Extraordinary growth as backlog keeps surging
summary_short: Revenue jumped to $3.77B from $2.45B a year ago and diluted EPS reached $13.91 versus $8.25; backlog rose to $17.81B, up from $14.06B at June 30.
summary_long: Net income was $489.0M. Operating cash flow topped $1B in a single quarter. Backlog grew $3.8B sequentially and more than $8.0B year over year; on a same-store basis it rose from $9.38B to $17.39B. Management says it expects to grow organically through year end and in 2027 while keeping profitability and cash flow high. No numeric guidance is given.
confidence_notes: Percent changes computed from the release's own current and prior-period figures (revenue $3,766.3M vs $2,451.0M; net income $489.0M vs $291.6M; diluted EPS $13.91 vs $8.25). Shard EPS (13.93) is the basic figure.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites strong ongoing demand and consistent execution by project teams, with relentless demand producing record backlog.
Sequential growth of $3.8 billion; same-store backlog rose to $17.39 billion from $9.38 billion a year ago, so acquisitions explain only a small part.
Management believes it is well positioned to grow organically through year end and in 2027 with high profitability and solid cash flow.
